candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether proxy participation weakness or recovery persisted alongside price and leadership changes, rather than relying on isolated snapshots.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews repeatedly cite point-in-time top-100 breadth with changing membership hashes and note that canonical breadth is unconfirmed; weekly reviews also lack a comparable breadth sequence.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped constituent breadth counts and advance ratios on a consistently defined universe
candidates.missing_history_problem: Existing breadth observations are sparse snapshots with changing membership, so the duration and ordering of participation deterioration or recovery cannot be assessed.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would clarify whether supportive or adverse settled flows persisted and how they aligned in time with price, breadth, and relative leadership.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews cite isolated settled sessions, divergent BTC and ETH flows, and missing flow direction or sequence across multiple sessions.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows by fund and asset
candidates.missing_history_problem: One or a few settled rows cannot distinguish persistent demand or outflows from a single-session observation or offsetting fund-level flows.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether relative weakness and price deterioration preceded, coincided with, or followed recoveries and drawdowns, reducing horizon and sequence ambiguity.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews report nominal horizons with shorter actual spans, differing cutoffs, and unavailable 1-hour anchors; weekly reviews lack aligned raw signal sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamp-aligned hourly BTC and ETH prices and ETH/BTC relative returns
candidates.missing_history_problem: Reported windows are not consistently full or synchronized, preventing reliable reconstruction of the event-time order and persistence of price and leadership changes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make prior forecast and warning calibration auditable against the information available when each candidate was issued, including errors and post-warning paths.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report missing candidate specifications and issue times, unavailable candidate-linked outcomes, incomplete outcome ingestion, and zero eligible prospective typed protection rows.
candidates.metric_name: Candidate-linked prospective outcome series from frozen specifications, issue-time evidence snapshots, and subsequent realized paths
candidates.missing_history_problem: Aggregate matured counts or retrospective weekly paths do not identify candidate-specific performance, broad-range containment, hindsight leakage, or post-warning upside and drawdown.
